subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve pending replies on forced restart

question: Should `openclaw gateway restart --force` adopt a bounded 5s best-effort drain before shutdown, and what proof/docs must land with that contract change?
rationale: Current help and docs promise immediate/no active-work wait, so the bug fix changes an operator-visible compatibility contract that automation should not accept silently.

options.title: Require proof and wording first
options.body: Ask for redacted live pending-reply restart proof and update CLI/docs wording before merging the 5s force-drain behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded force contract
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept the 5s delay as the new force behavior even before broader restart-replay work is complete.

options.title: Keep force immediate
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a different recovery design if `--force` must remain an immediate operator escape hatch.

recommendation.title: Require proof and wording first
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live pending-reply restart proof and update CLI/docs wording before merging the 5s force-drain behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and release-history touches put this person closest to the present gateway restart implementation being changed.
